SELECT user_id AS userId, loginName, SUM(onlineTime) AS onlineTime, SUM(loginCount) AS loginCount, tenant_id AS tenantId, tenant_name AS tenantName, loginUserName FROM ( SELECT dataTable.tenant_id, dataTable.tenant_name, dataTable.login_name AS loginUserName, user_id, IFNULL( dataTable.nick_name, '' ) AS loginName, IFNULL( cast( SUM( dataTable.login_count ) AS DECIMAL ( 10, 0 )), 0 ) AS loginCount, 0 AS onlineTime FROM vm_statistics_custom_duration AS dataTable
GROUP BY dataTable.user_id union all SELECT tenant_id AS tenant_id, '' AS tenant_name, '' AS loginUserName, user_id, dataTable.nick_name AS loginName, 0 AS loginCount, cast( SUM( dataTable.online_time ) AS DECIMAL ( 10, 0 )) AS onlineTime FROM vm_statistics_user_online_time dataTable
GROUP BY dataTable.user_id HAVING onlineTime >= '60' ) b GROUP BY b.user_id ORDER BY onlineTime + 0 DESC, loginCount + 0 DESC, tenantId ASC
